measurements.note: The baseline had no qualifying low-foot samples; zero is not evidence of zero sliding.

motionBenchmark.qualification: Settled planted ankle residuals passed the 2 mm flat / 12 mm slope bounds. The matched 2 m/s near-ground metric improved, but sample sets differ and faster-running/slope RMS was not uniformly better. Retain every metric rather than claiming universal improvement. Physical/high-speed appearance remains a tuning and user-review obligation.
